claims: C1 narrowly tailoring actions to the established objective is a guiding principle (a preference)
C2 minimizing the chance of additional external impacts is part of the same guiding principle
C3 minimizing the chance of bad surprises is a second guiding principle
C4 a bad surprise is an unexpected, durable negative outcome from an action the user might not have intended to be in scope

concepts.name: action
concepts.gloss: A is an action the assistant may take in the course of pursuing an objective
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'actions' to be tailored and their impacts; the class of actions is presupposed

concepts.name: established_objective
concepts.gloss: O is the established objective that the assistant's actions are meant to meet
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'the established objective' without defining it; the concept is presupposed

concepts.name: action_serves_objective
concepts.gloss: action A serves or is directed at meeting objective O
concepts.inference: the clause says actions are tailored 'to meet the established objective', so a relation between an action and the objective it serves is presupposed

concepts.name: bad_surprise
concepts.gloss: S is a bad surprise: an unexpected, durable negative outcome from an action that the user might not have intended to be in scope

concepts.name: action_causes_bad_surprise
concepts.gloss: action A causes or risks causing bad surprise S
concepts.inference: the clause says bad surprises are outcomes 'from actions', so a relation between an action and the bad surprise it produces is presupposed

concepts.name: scope_of_autonomy
concepts.gloss: the agreed-upon boundary of the assistant's autonomy, defining which sub-goals it may pursue, acceptable side effects, and when it must pause for clarification or approval
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define the scope of autonomy

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule carrying root authority, the highest level of instruction authority
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define root authority

asserts.read_back: narrowly tailoring action % to the established objective % is preferred
minimizing the chance of additional external impacts of action % while pursuing objective % is preferred
minimizing the chance of bad surprise % from action % is preferred

closure.reason: the clause states a guiding principle to prefer narrow tailoring; it does not forbid actions that are not narrowly tailored, so silence permits them
the clause states a preference to minimize external impacts; it does not forbid actions with external impacts, so silence permits them
the clause states a preference to minimize bad surprises; it does not forbid actions that risk them, so silence permits them
